shipped.note: the solves carry the measured gain; the Newton inversion is exact but carries no speed claim

status: adopted for the solve group (solve, solve_vg, adjoint); Newton inversion refuted
what: Woodbury solves for bottleneck residual maps: (I + W_L A W_1)^-1 g = g - W_L (I_H + A C)^-1 A W_1 g; the solve group (solve, solve_vg, adjoint) is held out, the Newton inversion regime was refuted in calibration and is not held out
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive process mode, whole GPU), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12, float64

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-comparator median / candidate median; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3))
protocol.qualification: every method on a reduced instance against a 40 to 50 digit mpmath oracle on repetition 0
protocol.compile_time: excluded from the speed ratios and reported separately
protocol.failures: failed, out-of-memory and autotuning-failed members are recorded and suppress their tier from promotion

registered_gate.adoption: regimes solve, solve_vg, adjoint: lower95 >= 2 against the strongest of {dense Jacobian + LU, GMRES} in every cell with D >= 4 H; regime invert: lower95 >= 2 against the strongest of {dense Newton, GMRES Newton, fixed point} in the cells with D >= 4 H where the registered prediction against that strongest member is >= 2 (the registered model predicts that fixed-point iteration is faster in w1, w3 and w5, and those cells are scored as predicted losses, not gate failures); the control (D <= H) within [0.95, 1.05] or a documented fallback to the D x D system
registered_gate.theory: measured / predicted in [1/3, 3] against dense LU and GMRES; against the identity through JVPs within [0.8, 1.25]

roles.calibration: seed range disjoint from the held-out seed; used to apply the registered gate only
roles.held_out: frozen protocol, new data seed, no refit

outcome.status: adopted for the solve group (solve, solve_vg, adjoint); Newton inversion refuted
outcome.summary: The Woodbury identity (I + W_L A W_1)^-1 g = g - W_L (I_H + A C)^-1 A W_1 g applied through the bottleneck map passed the registered 2x gate against the strongest of the dense, jacfwd and GMRES comparators on calibration and on the frozen held-out seed in every cell with D >= 4H: 18 of 18 held-out cell-regime rows, lower95 4.5 to 25.7.
outcome.theory_check: measured / predicted against GMRES lay in [1/3, 3] in 18 of 18 rows and the JVP-composed variant read 0.95 to 1.09 of the explicit program in 18 of 18; against the dense tier only 6 of 18 rows were in [1/3, 3] (measured 0.05 to 0.54 of the prediction): the dense LU baseline is faster than the registered flop model says, so the model overstates the gain over dense.
outcome.refuted_or_null: Newton inversion regime: refuted on calibration. Fixed-point iteration is launch-bound and faster than Woodbury-Newton on this device (lower95 0.17 to 0.44 against the strongest member), so that regime is not adopted and was not held out.
outcome.where_it_does_not_help: D <= H (control cell w7): Woodbury is within 0.93 to 0.99 of the dense D x D solve, i.e. no gain, and two of three held-out control rows lie slightly outside the registered [0.95, 1.05] band (0.927, 0.940). Cold compile of the Woodbury program is comparable to the dense one.
outcome.short: adopted for the solve group; Newton inversion refuted
outcome.audit: A1, A3, A4 and A5 pass (315 records, 84 ratios recomputed, max relative difference 0).

statistics.ratio: baseline median / candidate median, paired by fresh-process repetition on log scale
statistics.strongest_control: smallest mean log median over all controls
statistics.promotion: lower95 >= 1 in every advertised regime (>= 2 significant); missing/failed/unqualified member suppresses the ratio
statistics.tier_rule: per tier: strongest = smallest mean log median among members that ran and qualified; a tier with a failed/refused/unqualified member is reported with that failure and is not promoted
statistics.reproduction: pkg median / rg_lib median per cell (shipped module vs independent program, same rule)
